functional_failure_definition.meaning: the operational event at which the device is recorded as functionally failed or no longer meets the experiment's operating criterion; it is not synonymous with an arbitrary DI threshold or the last available timestamp
required_evidence: original run log or experiment record
device failure/stop annotation or maintenance record
endpoint timestamp/cycle and relation to the recorded trajectory
whether the run is run-to-failure or censored
functional_failure_definition.accepted_outcome: quote or faithfully paraphrase the source definition, identify the source file/page/record, and encode one deterministic endpoint rule
functional_failure_definition.frozen_endpoint_rule: For each anonymised unit u, endpoint T_u is the final observed cycle whose RUL equals 0; target RUL at cycle t is T_u - t. This follows the source convention that total close-open operations until failure define lifetime.
rejected_outcomes: inferring failure from a DI curve alone
using the last row as failure without source support
mixing functional failure with censoring or scheduled shutdown
functional_failure_definition.current_status: Acceptance report supplies engineering failure forms; chinese_paper Section 6.2.2 supplies complete-trajectory and endpoint convention; DI table endpoint identities verified for all 38 units
